citation.authors: Hjorth M, Galigniana NM, Ween O et al.
citation.title: Postprandial Effects of Salmon Fishmeal and Whey on Metabolic Markers in Serum and Gene Expression in Liver Cells

population.description: Five healthy men; 'between 33 and 45 years old and had a BMI of 21.5 to 24.0 kg/m2' (observed). Inclusion age >= 20 y, BMI 18.5-24.9; exclusion high blood pressure, known diabetes, dairy or fish intolerance; ferritin, AST, ALT, GGT within reference ranges.

protocols.name: fishmeal_capsules
protocols.description: 30 capsules of salmon fishmeal (7.50 g fishmeal, 5.2 g protein as printed) with 0.5 L water after an 8-12 h fast; samples at 0, 30, 60 min. Fat derived: 7.50 g x 13.2 g/100 g (Table 1) = 0.99 g. Carbohydrate: Table 1 prints '-' for fishmeal, entered as 0.0 (not a printed number). Capsules also held cellulose and excipients, not entered. Paper gives the fast as 8-12 h and no clock hour (both assumed); capsule cellulose is a 2.7-7.2 g range, not a value, so not entered.

meals.food: salmon fishmeal capsules with 0.5 L water

protocols.name: whey_capsules
protocols.description: 30 capsules of whey protein powder WPC 80 (6.75 g whey, 5.2 g protein as printed) with 0.5 L water after an 8-12 h fast; samples at 0, 30, 60 min. Derived from Table 1 per 100 g: fat 6.75 x 6.5/100 = 0.43875 -> 0.44 g; carbohydrate and sugar 6.75 x 8.0/100 = 0.54 g. Capsules also held cellulose and excipients, not entered. Paper gives the fast as 8-12 h and no clock hour (both assumed); capsule cellulose is a 2.7-7.2 g range, not a value, so not entered.

meals.food: whey protein (WPC 80) capsules with 0.5 L water
